name: Gambling Den
author: Oddisz
description: A back-room gambling den at every port of size 6 or more. Sell surplus hulls for tokens, then feed them to the machine. Most reels bust; the ones that do not pay credits, tokens, weapon crates and hull mod boxes - a large box is ten hull mod blueprints at once, and the machine never hands you one you already know. Set it up how you like: one reel or five, low stakes or high. Crate sizes and odds are LunaLib sliders.
